title: As a blessed saint, saint Anselm, writes in his book on similitudes, they are not even able to remove from the eye a worm that gnaws it
html_source:
St. Anselm was a Benedictine Monk and a Philosopher.

He is probobaly most famous for his Ontological Argument for God’s existence.
